pages.title: Read the Mechanism
pages.text: Music ruin: read the tablet, then play the bells in order. Return to the controller to retry. In the seal vault, use the central controller for the next lamp direction. Each click toggles that lamp and its clockwise neighbour.

pages.title: Door and Treasure
pages.text: Solving opens the seal and creates a shared reward chest above the controller, once only. If blocked, clear that space and use the controller again. The enclosed rear workshop contains an enchanting table, bookshelves and a smithing table. Its seal and shell cannot be mined in survival.
